scenario: Two contented cat friends curl up together on a windowsill, one washing the other's ear, tails looping into a heart shape — calm best friends, not fighting. A small round friendly FIV-virus character with short blunt rounded studs (never spikes/rays) sits harmlessly in the corner outside a closed cat-flap decorated with a heart sticker, waving hello. Deliberately mirrors the set's 'show how it's dealt with, not the harm' convention (peace between cats, a closed door) rather than depicting a bite or fight.

prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080.

THIS IS A MACRO CLOSE-UP SHOT, LIKE A ZOOMED-IN PHONE CAMERA PHOTO TAKEN TOO CLOSE. The subject is so close to the "camera" that it does NOT fully fit in the frame: the cats' heads and ears are CUT OFF by the TOP edge, the cats' bodies are CUT OFF by the LEFT and RIGHT edges, and their tails/paws are CUT OFF by the BOTTOM edge. There must be ZERO empty white background/wall/window space visible anywhere in the image — every single part of the 1080x1080 canvas is covered by either black line-art or white space that belongs INSIDE a drawn shape (fur, door, virus body). If you can see plain empty background at any edge, the drawing is WRONG — redo it bigger and closer.

SCENE (draw it oversized, then let the frame crop it): Two contented cartoon CAT friends sit pressed together, one washing the other's ear (tongue out, happy), their two tails looping into a heart shape low in the frame near the bottom edge, tails cropped by the bottom edge. Their heads/ears touch or cross the TOP edge of the canvas. Their bodies fill nearly the entire width, touching or crossing BOTH the left and right edges. Tucked into the bottom-right corner, half cropped by the corner itself, is a small round FRIENDLY cartoon FIV-virus character: a simple smooth ball with a cheerful face (two dot eyes, small smile) and only five or six SHORT, BLUNT, ROUNDED stud bumps sitting flush and close to its body like little knuckles — NOT spikes, NOT rays, NOT thorns. It waves one stubby bump hello, calm and harmless. Behind the cats, just a single simple heart-shaped sticker on the wall (no picture frame, no window, no other objects) — keep the background almost bare so the cats and the little virus character are the only large shapes, and they must be enormous relative to the canvas.

STYLE — coloring book line art: BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed. NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black fills anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only). Simple, cheerful, chunky shapes with open white space INSIDE each shape for colouring.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN:
- Any visible empty white background, wall, sky or margin space — the artwork must be so zoomed-in and oversized that it touches or crosses every one of the four edges, with elements literally cut off by the edges.
- ANY starburst, radiating burst, sparkle rays, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, or halo of rays anywhere.
- Virus rim bumps drawn as pointed spikes, thorns or anything radiating outward — short blunt rounded studs only, close to the body.
- ANY rectangle, box outline, picture frame, panel edge, border line or vignette around the whole picture.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks.
- NO speech bubble or thought bubble (added separately afterwards).
- NO fighting, no bite marks, no blood, no medical tools, no sick or sad animal.
- NO full human figure or human face anywhere.
- The virus character never touches, bites or chases either cat.
